name: spine-widened-invariants-audit
body:
Widened-invariant sweep of the spine-backfill spec, after I1-I5 were already clean. Results (counts: before -> after):

I1-I5 unchanged and still clean.
I6 person/user linkage: represents edges 0 -> 0; persons all `uses` the system (3), users all `contains` requirements (2). Model does not use represents — see global.note.represents-unused.
I7 domain structure: entities in a group 9/9; groups with >=1 entity 4/6 (upgrade, validation have none — justified as capability groups, see domain.note.group-less-domains-audit); uncontained values 1 -> 0 (item-context now in domain.group.templating); uncontained services 1 (render-sections, left open/ambiguous).
I8 solution structure: 30/30 components contained by a container; 4/4 containers contained by solution.system.kalide; 30/30 components have >=1 implemented-by; 30/30 have >=1 realised-by. Clean before and after.
I9 tier-1 structure: 3 stakeholders, 2 users, 81 requirements, 81/81 requirements reachable from a stakeholder (I4). Users cannot be contained by a Stakeholder — the binary refuses Stakeholder->User; they are anchored the schema-legal way (stakeholder -> every user-rooted requirement, already recorded in requirements.note.spine-stakeholder-reachability).
I10 service anchors: 13/13 services realised-by a solution node; 13/13 driven by >=1 requirement. Clean.
I5+ integrity: no dangling authored endpoints; no contains or depends-on cycles; every constraint attaches-to resolves; all authored edge kinds are schema-legal (contains, drives, realised-by, implemented-by, depends-on, details, uses person->system, calls service->service, publishes/subscribes service->event).

Net change this round: one contains edge (domain.group.templating -> domain.value.item-context), plus notes recording the ambiguous/open items. [autonomous]
